background:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: ONE fixed empty 16:9 background plate for CANCEL CITY's Gordon Ramen cinematic. Supplied card is only a style reference; remove all people and food in foreground.
Environment: a cheap filthy instant-noodle FOOD-COURT KITCHEN after closing. At rear and sides are scuffed stainless-steel kitchen counters, a stovetop with a few EMPTY metal stockpots, old extraction hood, blank grease-stained rectangular wall poster, hanging black frying pans, grimy square tile splashback and unbranded cupboard doors. The central and left foreground must be entirely open cracked concrete/tile floor so a full-body fighting chef can stand there. Wide perspective at waist height, lower half clear floor, background counters kept distant along back wall.
Lighting: lurid acid-yellow fluorescent tubes, red-magenta ambient shadows, deep black ink. Dirty silver stainless steel with tiny cyan edge highlights. Match dense harsh black hand scratched etching, crosshatched stipple, gritty ugly cheap screenprint texture of the exact current card. Not glossy digital paint, polished anime, clean vector or photorealistic3D.
STRICT: empty. No chef, person, creature, face, silhouette, human body parts, bowl, instant-noodle cup, noodles, food, splashes, steam, smoke, fire, floating particles or energy effects. No objects blocking the open foreground stage. No readable text, letters, logos, labels, numbers, card frame or watermark. All surfaces stable and fixed for later compositing.
endingFramingCorrection:
Edit this transparent eight-pose Gordon Ramen sheet. KEEP exactly the same EIGHT poses, identities, clothes, cup and fork, dense scratched black etching, stipple and angry face. Correct ONLY spacing and framing. Original top hair and bottom boots touch the outer canvas edge; fix by REDUCING EACH FIGURE'S SIZE about25% and adding generous true-transparent padding.
Exactly TWO COLUMNS by FOUR ROWS on a portrait canvas. Every equal cell must have at least40pixels of clear transparent space above highest hair and below lowest boot as well as left and right of extended hands. All eight figures entirely visible with COMPLETE spiky hair and COMPLETE boots, never clipped. Each whole intact character must fit safely INSIDE its own equal cell with broad transparent gutters; no figure pixels on the canvas outer edge. Smaller figures and wider margins are intentional.
Preserve exact row-major sequence: foldedarmsdisapproval, sterncupinspection, shoutingverdict, forkpointsatcupnoodle, pushes cup away, fedup sagging, deadpandisgust, final eyesclosed dinner-declined hand gesture. Same wild short blond hair/darkroots, deeplycreasedsunreddenedface, foodstainedwhitedoublebreastedchefjacketrolledupsleeves,blackpants,chunkyblacklaceupboots,magenta/yellow/teal instantnoodlecupandshortsilverfork. Do not change appearance or style. No extra noodles, steam, effects, scenery, ground, shadows, labels or text. ACTUAL alpha transparency around all figures.
